title: AI-Powered Network Quality Prediction for Seamless Online Event Planning
summary: AI4Africa proposes an unnamed AI system that forecasts connection quality for online events; its only testbed is a public Kaggle dataset, and no pilot is reported.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: AI4Africa, an organization in Nigeria, proposes forecasting connection quality from a dataset to help plan online events. Its account in the 2025 report of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), current as of June 2025 gives the use case status as not applicable. It names a public internet speed dataset from Kaggle as its only testbed, and it states that a proof of concept depends on scholarships and funding. Avoided disruption and access benefits are unreported. The 2026 interim edition of the ITU compendium does not list the project, and no later paper or report describes a prototype or pilot as of 29 October 2026.
purpose: Help organizers plan online activities around likely network conditions.

ratings.reason: Remote participants are intended to obtain more reliable online access.
Event organizers and institutions are intended to plan around poor connectivity, and no event outcome is reported.
